title: MV Problem with the Equipment Set Bonuses plugin for RPG Maker MV

posts.author: kirillkrm
posts.body:
I bought the Equipment Set Bonuses plugin for RPG Maker MV on itch -
link to the plugin page
.
I really like this plugin, but an unexpected problem has arisen. The plugin allows you to combine weapons and armor into sets of equipment.
I created 10 sets and everything worked fine, but when I created 6 more sets (16 in total) the plugin just stopped working. The effects don't work, pop-up menus with their descriptions don't even appear. It's like there's no plug-in.
Has anyone encountered a similar problem with this plugin? Maybe someone is familiar with the plugin developer (Olivia) and can tell me if there is a way to contact?

posts.author: ShadowDragon
posts.body: does it stop for each armor (the first 10 you made before)?

posts.author: kirillkrm
posts.body:
ShadowDragon said:
does it stop for each armor (the first 10 you made before)?
Click to expand...
I apologize. I created this topic earlier than I should have. The problem was not in the quantity, but in one separate set of equipment. I made it specific, with only one bonus, but in order to activate this bonus, it was necessary to collect 7 things from the set at once. When I changed this condition, everything suddenly worked, and for all sets! It is strange that 1 set cancels everything at once, but, most importantly, I understood what the reason was. Now I can simply delete one problematic set and make it again.
